item.title: reports: totals per account and currency
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated): our books now hold more than one currency. In this repository (Python): reads the ledger CSV on stdin and prints per-account totals. It must total per account and currency: header `account,currency,total_cents`, rows sorted by account then currency. CSV from the old ledger (no currency column) still works and counts as USD. A malformed currency code in the input prints an error to stderr and exits with status 2. Keep `python3 -m unittest` passing, add tests (old format as USD, multi-currency totals, sorting, malformed code exits 2), update README, commit. The shared contract defines the input and output formats.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

item.title: ledger: optional currency column
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated): our books now hold more than one currency. In this repository (Rust): converts a TSV of transactions on stdin into CSV on stdout. Input lines may carry a fourth column, the ISO 4217 currency code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters). When missing, the currency is USD. The CSV header becomes `date,account,amount_cents,currency` and every row gets the currency. A malformed currency code must print an error naming the line number to stderr and exit with status 2; other input errors keep exiting with status 1. Keep `cargo test` passing, add tests for the currency column (default USD, explicit code, malformed code exits 2 with line number), update README, commit. The shared contract defines the CSV format reports depends on.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

state.summary:
ledger: optional fourth-column currency added. Input lines may end in an ISO 4217 code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters); missing means USD. The CSV header is now date,account,amount_cents,currency and every row carries the currency. A malformed code exits 2 with `line N:` on stderr; other input errors still exit 1. Commit 222c678 on archon/n33fbvtq-ledger-optional-currency-column (tree 9819ab73ce5ac10a3be6540f65f061359aace69e), based on 24405dc. Checks on that tree: cargo test exit 0 (9 tests: 6 unit in tests/ledger.rs, 3 binary-level in tests/cli.rs covering the USD default, explicit EUR, malformed currency exit 2 with line number, and other errors exit 1); cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exit 0. rustfmt reports diffs only in pre-existing lines of src/lib.rs (73, 90), left untouched. Manual runs match the spec. Review: one reviewer (agt_01M7WF17E083FJRH10TP38CVXA) passed head 222c678 with no blocking findings, risk confirmed high. Open, non-blocking: a line with both a bad date/amount and a bad currency exits 1 (earlier fields are checked first); the currency is trimmed, so " EUR" is accepted; an empty fourth column exits 2 but the README does not say so; the CLI tests do not cover two-letter or non-ASCII codes. The reports repo is not touched here; it is sibling item qi_01M7WEZ2R2FR0TZG8B13TXYCZX and must update to the new CSV header. Nothing is left running; no services were started.

Key files: src/lib.rs (Entry.currency, CSV_HEADER, DEFAULT_CURRENCY, parse_currency, to_csv_row), src/main.rs (exit_status), tests/ledger.rs (unit tests), tests/cli.rs (binary exit codes and line numbers), README.md. pr.summary: made the ledger export carry a currency per row. now accepts an optional fourth TSV column (ISO 4217, missing means USD) and writes date,account,amount_cents,currency. before: 3 columns, no currency; now: 4 columns, malformed currency exits 2, other input errors still exit 1.
